_about: The command reference: one page per tool, at docs/reference/<tool>/. Nothing here restates the tool. Each command names its help entries by their opening words, and the page shows those entries as the tool prints them, from that tool's captured help in site/transcripts.json. An entry belongs to the claim that matches the most of its opening words. Every entry in the help's USAGE and FLAGS blocks must belong to exactly one claim, and every claim must win an entry, so a new command or flag in the help stops the build until it has a place here. operations names the capability-contract operations the command runs; the page lists their refusal codes and their reads and writes from the newest docs/contracts/v<N>/<tool>.json, and every operation in that contract must belong to a command. says is the one sentence written here. examples names captured --json runs in site/transcripts.json; the page shows each one, and a table of its details keys built from it.

commands.title: Plan
commands.says: Scans a folder and shows the plan. Nothing moves.

commands.title: Review
commands.says: Walks each group in a terminal, so you can rename or skip it, then applies.

commands.title: Apply
commands.says: Scans again and moves every group it finds then.

commands.title: Saved plans
commands.says: Saves a plan to a file, then moves exactly that plan.

commands.title: Finder tags
commands.says: Plans Finder tags to add, by extension. Nothing moves.

commands.title: Propose
commands.says: Checks per-file folder decisions against a saved plan and writes a new plan.
claims: sweep propose --plan F --plan-digest SHA --proposal P --export-plan OUT

commands.title: Undo
commands.says: Moves the files of one apply back.

commands.title: Status
commands.says: Reports undo records as JSON.

commands.title: Forget
commands.says: Removes sweep's undo records.

commands.title: Verify
commands.says: Prints sweep's own privacy posture.

commands.title: Contract
commands.says: Prints the versioned capability contract as JSON. It reads no application files and changes no application state.

commands.title: Lesson
commands.says: Runs seven exercises against a folder you can throw away.

commands.title: Stash a folder
commands.says: Moves the folder's visible items into a hidden holding folder in the same folder.

commands.title: Select
commands.says: Stashes only the items you name.

commands.title: Saved plans
commands.says: Saves a plan to a file, then stashes exactly that plan.

commands.title: Pop
commands.says: Moves stashed items back where they were.

commands.title: Status
commands.says: Shows what is stashed, and when it is due back.

commands.title: Inspect
commands.says: Lists the item ids of one stash and what it still holds.

commands.title: Contract
commands.says: Prints the versioned capability contract as JSON. It reads no application files and changes no application state.

commands.title: Extract
commands.says: Opens an archive into one new folder, or places nothing.

commands.title: List
commands.says: Shows what an archive holds. Nothing is placed.

commands.title: Contract
commands.says: Prints the versioned capability contract as JSON. It reads no application files and changes no application state.
